items.source: Enter the retrieve workflow and use the returned RestClient.ResponseSpec to select from a number of built-in options to extract the response.
items.translation: 进入检索工作流，并使用返回的RestClient.ResponseSpec从多种内置选项中选择一个来提取响应。

items.source: Provide a function to map specific error status codes to an error handler.
items.translation: 提供一个函数，将特定的错误状态代码映射到错误处理器。

items.source: Set the hint with the given name to the given value for SmartHttpMessageConverters supporting them.
items.translation: 将名为给定名称的提示设置为给定值，以支持它们的`SmartHttpMessageConverter`。
